name: hcportal_getTimezonesForGeography
description: Returns the distinct timezones used by cities in a given country (optionally narrowed to a region). Powers the manual timezone dropdown shown when a run's location is entered as free text ('Other' region/city) with no structured city to derive a timezone from. Requires standard portal authentication.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: Required filter: only timezones used by cities in this country are returned.

parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: Optional filter: when provided, narrows the result to timezones used by cities in this region.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on any validation, auth, or runtime error. Short-circuits on first error.

rowsets.name: TimezonesForGeographyResult
rowsets.description: Distinct timezones used by cities in the geography, ordered by displayName. Empty if the geography has no cities/timezones.

columns.name: ianaTimeZone
columns.description: IANA zone name, e.g. 'Europe/London' (may be null)

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
